## Expectations

- Discuss challenges, open questions (presentation will not be graded)
- Engage with the other presentations (constructively, respectfully)

Note: It is instructive to see how differently the groups present their work.

- Ask yourselves: What would you adopt and what would you do differently? Why?
- You often see how presentations were created (Powerpoint, Slides, even Quarto presentations) and whether AI was used.

Suggest "sounding-board prompts" like "You are an academic machine learning expert. Review the slides and identify errors and unusual notation." (maybe even open ChenChan2004; Figure 1)
